{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Sabotage_droid.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A sabotage droid]]
'''Sabotage droids''' were a class of [[Spy droid/Legends|spy droid]] designed to sabotage enemy vehicles and installations. The [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|Pistoeka sabotage droid]] was one type of sabotage droid.

Another model was repulsorlift [[Droid/Legends|droids]] equipped with electrical prods and bladed rotors. They were also equipped with [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth field generators]]. They saw use during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in the battles of [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], [[Battle of Behpour|Behpour]], [[Battle of Juma 9|Juma 9]], and [[Mission to Alzoc III|Alzoc III]].

==History==
{{Quote|Don't they know when to give up?|Ahsoka, during the Battle of Ryloth|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''</ref>}}
At the Battle of Ryloth, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] encountered these droids while scouting the ruins of the planet's cities. Later, the droids attacked [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] on his [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|AT-RT]] patrol. When Rex and [[Boomer (Advanced Recon Force trooper)|Boomer]] were captured by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]] fought off waves of sabotage droids. When Rex was covering Anakin, more sabotage droids made an appearance.

Sabotage droids were part of [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress's]] attack force to guard a superweapon located in the remains of a [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|Munificent-class star frigate]] wreck on the surface of [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]]. They attacked the Republic forces with their lasers. The Jedi [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] used the droids to destroy power generators so they could ascertain how the Separatist ship was destroyed. The droids then continued to attack the clones and Jedi until the battle was won in favor of the Republic forces.

The sabotage droids at [[Juma 9]] were in charge of guarding [[Kul Teska]] while he was trying to use the ship's sensor array. They attacked all of the clone and Jedi forces in the station. They also attacked [[Switch (clone trooper)|CP-6824]] and the Jedi when the clone tried to determine Teska's reasons for attacking the facility. When Switch hacked the computer, the group was later surrounded by a squad of the droids. They were all later destroyed by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]].

===Battle of Behpour===
The sabotage droids at [[Behpour/Legends|Behpour]] were a component of the droid forces protecting the base from the invading [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and clone troopers. They attacked AT-RTs during a distraction move by the Republic. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Padawan]] used the Force to "jack" them, and used them against [[Kul Teska]] at the [[Behpour facility]].
